raw_market.description:
In the first quarter of the college football game between Washington and Purdue, scheduled for October 16 at 8:00 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Over" if Washington and Purdue combine to score 17 or more points in the first quarter.

If the combined first quarter total is less than 17, this market will resolve to "Under".

Only points scored during that period count; overtime is not included.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
